description: Fix the auto-ship-on-CLEAN wedge: move the auto-ship dispatch out of runSupervisor into runSidecarLoop after clearActive so phase:shipping is the last state-file write on the terminal complete path and survives teardown.

userStories.title: Move auto-ship dispatch from runSupervisor to runSidecarLoop post-clearActive
userStories.description: As the cam sidecar in auto mode, I need the auto-ship decision (complete check, CLEAN check, fire-once marker write, phase:shipping write) to run in the outer sidecar loop AFTER clearActive so that phase:shipping is the last state-file write on the terminal complete path and is never clobbered by the onProgress unlink-on-complete or by clearActive rewriting the file as phase:idle.
acceptanceCriteria: runSupervisor (src/supervisor/loop.ts) no longer accepts an autoShipFn parameter and its terminal complete branch contains no auto-ship dispatch: no autoShipDispatchedAt marker write and no phase:shipping write remain inside runSupervisor. [oracle: ! grep -q 'supervisorOpts.autoShipFn' src/supervisor/loop.ts]

runSidecarLoop performs the auto-ship decision AFTER clearActive, symmetric with the flipActive auto-chain block: when the just-returned supervisor result has status === 'complete', prd.review.lastVerdict === 'CLEAN', the auto-ship capability is provided (auto mode), and prd.review.autoShipDispatchedAt === undefined, it writes the autoShipDispatchedAt marker to prd.json and writes phase:shipping to the cam-loop state file as the LAST state-file write of that tick. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/auto-chain.test.ts]
Auto-ship fires ONLY on result.status === 'complete'; a terminal awaiting-operator result does not dispatch auto-ship. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/auto-chain.test.ts]

Fire-once semantics preserved per ADR 0008: the prd.review.autoShipDispatchedAt marker in prd.json dedupes the dispatch across ticks and sidecar restarts (guard autoShipDispatchedAt === undefined); the marker is never cleared or re-armed by this change. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/auto-chain.test.ts]
Operator mode (no auto-ship capability wired into runSidecarLoop opts) does not auto-ship and does not crash on the complete path. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/auto-chain.test.ts]
MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT terminal never dispatches auto-ship (only CLEAN does), asserted at the new outer-loop callsite. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/non-convergence-autochain.test.ts]
makeClearActive is exported from src/commands/sidecar.ts. [oracle: grep -q 'export function makeClearActive' src/commands/sidecar.ts]

All existing tests that exercised the old inner-supervisor callsite (test/supervisor/auto-chain.test.ts, test/sidecar-ship-phase.test.ts, test/supervisor/loop.test.ts ordering-invariant test, test/supervisor/non-convergence-autochain.test.ts) are updated to the new outer-loop contract and pass. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Full quality spine passes including biome lint. [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/loop.ts (remove autoShipFn from RunSupervisorOptions and the dispatch at ~841-851; remove the supervisorOpts.autoShipFn threading at ~1886-1888; add the post-clearActive dispatch block right at ~1905-1914 next to the flipActive auto-chain block), src/commands/sidecar.ts (export makeClearActive at line 307; rewire the auto-ship capability at ~2007-2010 and the deps threading at ~2124-2131), plus the four test files listed in the ACs. WHAT, not HOW, but honor the spec letter: the four-gate decision (complete + CLEAN + capability present + marker undefined) is observable at the runSidecarLoop level; either wire prd read/write into RunSidecarLoopOptions or extend the injected capability, as long as loop.ts gates on result.status === 'complete' and the marker write goes to prd.json before the phase write. Gotchas from the spec: (1) the bug is a DETERMINISTIC clobber chain, not a race: setPhase shipping (loop.ts:850) then onProgress unlinkSync on complete (src/supervisor/host.ts:713-719) then clearActive recreates the file as idle (loop.ts:1905); the fix makes phase:shipping the LAST write. (2) clearActive writes phase:idle IMPLICITLY: makeClearActive omits phase and passes active:false so renderStateFile derives effectivePhase 'idle' (src/commands/next.ts:109-110); grepping for setPhase('idle') finds nothing. (3) ADR 0013 supersedes ONLY the callsite location of ADR 0008; the anchoring semantics (complete-only dispatch, prd.json marker, no explicit await-operator gate) are preserved. (4) The outer block runs only on ticks where runSupervisor actually executed; after complete, active flips false so idle ticks skip it: natural fire-once plus the prd.json marker guarantee single dispatch. (5) Keep the phase:shipping signal and its single consumer at loop.ts:1795 (runShipPhaseFn) unchanged; only WHERE/WHEN the signal is written moves. (6) test/supervisor/loop.test.ts:3647 asserts teardownWorkerPaneFn runs AFTER autoShipFn; with the move, teardown stays inner (CAM-188) and auto-ship becomes outer post-return, so rewrite that ordering invariant accordingly. (7) Auto-ship and flipActive are mutually exclusive because complete implies no pending stories. OUT OF SCOPE: the onProgress unlink-on-complete (leave intact; last-write makes it inert), src/commands/ship.ts manual path, CAM-208 drain spam.

userStories.title: Real-writer regression test: phase:shipping survives the terminal teardown
userStories.description: As a cam-cli maintainer, I need a regression test that drives runSidecarLoop's terminal complete tick with the REAL state-file writers (not no-op fakes) so that the CAM-191 clobber chain can never silently regress: every pre-existing auto-ship test injects clearActive no-ops and hard-codes readLoopPhaseFn, so none of them can observe the clobber.
acceptanceCriteria: A new regression test drives runSidecarLoop's terminal complete tick with the REAL state-file writers (real makeSetPhaseFn, real exported makeClearActive, and the real onProgress unlink-on-complete behavior) against a real temporary cam-loop state file and a real temporary prd.json. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/auto-ship-real-writers.test.ts]
The test asserts that after the complete tick the state file exists on disk and carries phase:shipping. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/auto-ship-real-writers.test.ts]

The test asserts that on the following tick readLoopPhaseFn (real parser over the same temp state file, NOT a hard-coded () => 'shipping') returns 'shipping' and runShipPhaseFn is invoked exactly once. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/auto-ship-real-writers.test.ts]

The test is verified to FAIL against the pre-fix code: temporarily restore the pre-fix supervisor from main, observe the test fail, restore the branch version, observe it pass; record the red-run evidence in the commit message. [oracle: git checkout origin/main -- src/supervisor/loop.ts && bun test test/supervisor/auto-ship-real-writers.test.ts (expect FAIL) && git checkout HEAD -- src/supervisor/loop.ts && bun test test/supervisor/auto-ship-real-writers.test.ts (expect PASS)]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Full quality spine passes including biome lint. [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: new test/supervisor/auto-ship-real-writers.test.ts (name is a suggestion; keep it under test/supervisor/); possibly a surgical export in src/supervisor/host.ts if the production onProgress factory is extracted rather than replicated. Construction hints: (1) use the REAL runSupervisor (runSidecarLoop defaults runSupervisorFn to it at loop.ts:1754) with a temp-dir prd.json whose stories all have passes:true and whose review.lastVerdict === 'CLEAN', so the complete terminal is reached on the first iteration without spawning any worker; (2) real writers come from src/commands/sidecar.ts: makeSetPhaseFn(claudeDir, cwd) and makeClearActive(claudeDir, cwd) (exported in US-001); the state file is .claude/cam-loop.local.md under the temp cwd; (3) the onProgress unlink-on-complete lives inline in src/supervisor/host.ts:713-719 (unlinkSync on terminalStatus === 'complete'); either export/extract that factory surgically or replicate the unlink faithfully in the injected buildOpts onProgress, since the point is that the unlink really removes the file mid-chain; (4) runSidecarLoop is an infinite loop; bound the run with the existing test harness patterns (a sleep that throws or a hasSessionFn latch sequence) used in test/sidecar-ship-phase.test.ts and test/supervisor/auto-chain.test.ts; (5) readLoopPhaseFn must parse the real temp state file (production makeReadLoopPhase in sidecar.ts or parseStateFile), never a constant closure; (6) the RED verification works because origin/main still carries the pre-fix loop.ts until this PR merges; run it before committing and paste the failing assertion into the commit message body; (7) writeStateFile used by the real writers may resolve paths relative to cwd: pass the temp cwd consistently to both factories so all writers hit the SAME file (the clobber chain only reproduces on a shared path).
